issues.description: The template defines a function named simulate_one_round(...) whereas the problem statement and the solution use the name simulate_msd_one_round(...). This name mismatch is structural (not just a missing body): other parts of the template (e.g. plot_msd) already call simulate_msd_one_round, and the solution implements simulate_msd_one_round. Students following the template will be confused (which name to implement) and tests or helper functions that expect simulate_msd_one_round will fail to find it.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename the template function simulate_one_round(...) to simulate_msd_one_round(...) (and update its NotImplementedError message accordingly) so the template signature and name match the problem statement and solution. Ensure any calls inside the template (e.g. plot_msd) consistently use the same function name.
